description: One row = one dataset (authoritative). Evidence for values is in evidence.csv
Spelling variants of channel names (case only) and spellings a dataset's own documentation maps to an electrode name. No mapping by convention (old to new 10-10 names, reference suffixes)
One row = evidence for one value of a column with evidence=yes, in datasets or in a dataset's child rows (acquisition_setups, tasks, participant_groups, access_routes)
One row = one source document (paper, page, license file, release files, BIDS metadata file, repository record, catalogue entry, recipe readme)
The sources that introduce a dataset: its paper, its distribution page, mirrors, catalogue entries, its recipe readme
Other names of a dataset
Relations between datasets (subset, version, distinct, suspected identity)
One row = one institution that recorded or distributes data
One row = one way to obtain the data (official page, repository, mirror, loader), with what a person must do on it
One row = one recording setup within a dataset (device, electrodes, montage, sampling rate). A dataset with mixed setups has several rows
One row = one channel of a setup, as the source names it
One row = one experimental task (paradigm) recorded in a dataset. Not a machine-learning benchmark (see benchmarks)
One row = one step of the sequence of a task (fixation, cue, imagery, rest, ...), in order
One row = one label set or annotation of a dataset (event markers, class labels, diagnoses, sleep stages, artifact marks, self-reports, ...)
Number of units (trials, segments, recordings, subjects) per label of an annotation, as a source (the documentation or the recipe readme) states it
One row = one group of participants (patients, controls, all) with the summary values a source gives
One row = one per-participant variable in the release (age, weight, BCI experience, ...), and how many participants have it
One row = one kind of quality information the data collectors provide (impedances, bad channel marks, artifact marks, ratings, notes)
One row = one form in which the data is distributed (raw, preprocessed, epoched, features), with the processing the provider applied
One row = one machine-learning task that a paper defined on the dataset, with its metric and reported result
One row = one problem of the release as distributed
